|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Trophy Of A Kill]]; it is the current text. The images are the Master List slip and the Players Committee card image, which print it; the release-sheet slip prints the original text (see [[Trophy Of A Kill]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Trophy Of A Kill]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Character is immunity to attrition +2 (and power +2 if female). May add 1 to Force drain where present. This device lost if character Disarmed.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-06-Trophy_Of_A_Kill.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows it without the comma after “Galen” and with “ability >3”<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref> (punctuation and spacing only; not treated as a separate version).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): after the persona-name change “Cyborg Commander ---> Grievous” (29 January 2013)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf.
